Class DefaultInterceptorChainFactory

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.aop.chain.DefaultInterceptorChainFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
InterceptorChainFactory
@Internal public final class DefaultInterceptorChainFactory extends Object implements InterceptorChainFactory
The chain factory. Candidates the caller does not supply are acquired through its candidate resolver and selected by the interceptor registry.
Since:
5.3.0

      public <T,R> MethodInvocationContext<T,R> buildMethodChain(T target, ExecutableMethod<T,R> method, Interceptor<T,R>[] interceptors, @Nullable Object... parameters)
      Description copied from interface: InterceptorChainFactory
      Builds a method invocation from interceptors already selected for its target. Generated proxies retain the factory and their selected arrays; this operation does not resolve beans or repeat matching.

    • buildLifecycleChain

      public <T,R> LifecycleInvocation<T,R> buildLifecycleChain(BeanResolutionContext resolutionContext, BeanDefinition<T> definition, ExecutableMethod<T,R> method, T bean, InterceptorKind kind, @Nullable Collection<BeanRegistration<Interceptor<?,?>>> candidates)
      Description copied from interface: InterceptorChainFactory
      Builds a lifecycle chain. A non-null candidate set, including an empty one, takes precedence over retained candidates. Null uses retained candidates, or compatibility discovery when none exist.
      Specified by:
      buildLifecycleChain in interface InterceptorChainFactory
      Type Parameters:
      T - The bean type
      R - The result type
      Parameters:
      resolutionContext - The resolution context
      definition - The bean definition
      method - The lifecycle method
      bean - The bean instance
      kind - The lifecycle interception kind
      candidates - Explicit candidates, or null to use retained candidates or discovery
      Returns:
      A new lifecycle chain; execute with LifecycleInvocation.proceedLifecycle()
